# Trek & Stay — Wilderness Trekking & Himalayan Expeditions

> Trek & Stay is an adventure trekking, glamping campsite network, and high-altitude Himalayan expedition organizer headquartered near Kollur, Karnataka, India. We operate curated Western Ghats trails, Sahyadri monsoon treks, waterfall rappelling, sacred Himalayan pilgrimages (Dodham Yatra), and the flagship sub-zero Winter Spiti Expedition.

## Quick Facts & Contacts
- **Headquarters**: Kodachadri Foothills Road, Near Mookambika Sanctuary, Kollur, Udupi District, Karnataka 576220, India
- **Official WhatsApp & Bookings**: +91 99029 37730
- **Official Email**: info@trekandstay.com
- **Official Website**: https://trekandstay.com/
- **Authorized Payee & UPI**: Ganapathi Bhat (`ganapathibhat5@ybl`, Canara Bank)
- **Primary Departure Hubs**: Chandigarh, Bengaluru, Pune, Mumbai, Delhi, Mangaluru, Mysuru, Hubballi

---

## Flagship Expeditions

### 1. Winter Spiti Expedition (8 Days / 7 Nights)
- **Price**: ₹23,000 per person (Chandigarh to Chandigarh)
- **Group Offer**: ₹1,000 OFF per person for bookings of 9 or more travelers
- **Route**: Chandigarh ➔ Shimla ➔ Narkanda ➔ Sangla & Chitkul ➔ Kalpa (Kinner Kailash) ➔ Nako & Khab Sangam ➔ Tabo Monastery ➔ Gue (500-yr Monk Mummy) ➔ Dhankar ➔ Kaza ➔ Key Monastery ➔ Chicham Bridge (13,596 ft) ➔ Langza Buddha ➔ Hikkim (World's Highest Post Office at 14,567 ft) ➔ Buffer Day ➔ Chandigarh
- **Highlights**: Sub-zero snow desert (-15°C to -25°C), frozen waterfalls, traditional Bukhari wood-heated homestays, small batches (max 12-14 guests)
- **Direct Link**: https://trekandstay.com/#spiti
- **Interactive Dossier & PDF**: https://trekandstay.com/#spiti

### 2. Dodham Yatra & Adventure Special (Kedarnath • Badrinath • Rishikesh) (7 Days / 6 Nights)
- **Price**: ₹17,500 (Ex-Delhi) / ₹34,000 (Ex-Bangalore with Flights)
- **Route**: Delhi / Bangalore ➔ Haridwar ➔ Devprayag ➔ Sonprayag ➔ Kedarnath Jyotirlinga (11,755 ft) ➔ Badrinath Dham ➔ Mana (First Village of India) ➔ Rishikesh River Rafting (16 km) & Bungee Jump
- **Highlights**: Sacred Jyotirlinga darshan, alpine mountain tents, pulse oximeter safety monitoring
- **Direct Link**: https://trekandstay.com/#dodham

### 3. Maharashtra Monsoon Trails (4 Nights / 5 Days)
- **Price**: ₹13,499 per person
- **Route**: Harishchandragad peak, Konkan Kada 1,400m cliff cloud inversion, Kalu 1,200ft waterfall, Harihar 80° vertical rock-cut stairs
- **Direct Link**: https://trekandstay.com/#destination-maharashtra-monsoon-trails

## How to Book
1. **Direct WhatsApp Booking**: Message +91 99029 37730 with destination name, preferred batch date, and traveler count.
2. **UPI Advance Token**: Transfer advance registration token (₹5,000 for Himalayan expeditions) to authorized UPI ID `ganapathibhat5@ybl` (Ganapathi Bhat) and share the 12-digit UTR reference for instant seat locking.
3. **Official PDF Brochure**: Download instant high-resolution 5-page brochures directly from the website without registration barriers.
